name: Popover
summary: Non-modal content anchored to the button that opens it, with no script.

guidance.useFor: Extra content or a few controls next to the button that opens it: sharing options, a mini form, more detail.
insteadUse: Anything that needs an answer before going on: Dialog
content: Keep it short; a popover isn't a page

rungReason: popover="auto" with command="toggle-popover" gives open and close, Esc, light dismiss, the top layer and the expanded state on its button, with no script.

a11y.role: None of its own: its content keeps its semantics; the button exposes expanded state (the platform)
a11y.name: n/a (give it a heading or aria-label when its content needs one)

keyboard.action: Close; focus stays or returns to the button
Moves into it from its button (it follows the button in the DOM)

rules: Render it right after its button: popovers are never portalled (RFC-0001 §5), so reading and Tab order follow
Non-modal: for anything that needs an answer, use Dialog
motion: Fades in and out; instant under reduced motion
contrast: An opaque surface and a strong ring
